verdict.language_detail: MATLAB (Coursera Machine Learning ex4 - Neural Network Learning)
verdict.provenance_detail: Coursera Machine Learning course by Andrew Ng, Exercise 4 - Neural Network Learning script
verdict.purpose: Driver script for Coursera ML Exercise 4: loads handwritten digit data, computes neural network cost (feedforward), implements regularization, sigmoid gradient, weight initialization, backpropagation, trains a two-layer neural network using fmincg, visualizes weights, and evaluates training accuracy.
